character: Rameses Najeer confronts Laura in the hidden Society of Amon Ra chamber
voice: Precise, grave, and formally threatening without a written lisp; the society is presented as a modern secret order rather than authentic ancient Egyptian practice.

entries.text: Ominous chanting echoes through the chamber as Laura stumbles upon a secret ceremony...
Ah... excuse me. I was looking for the ladies' lounge?
You are coming with us, Miss Bow.
Um... I think you're making a mistake.
You have seen too much. We cannot allow you to leave.
Not to worry! I won't remember this room, or you, or anything at all. Really! I have a terrible memory. I can scarcely remember my own name.
I regret that you found us. The Society of Amon Ra must remain secret. Too many powerful people have too much at stake.
A secret society devoted to Amon Ra? In the museum basement?
This chamber was forgotten when the original museum was rebuilt. We are safe here, provided no outsider discovers us.
My lips are sealed. If you want to chant and hold little meetings down here, that's your business.
You cannot be trusted, Miss Bow. You are a newspaper reporter. Release you, and we may decorate tomorrow's front page.
But people will miss me! They'll search the museum!
The police will never find this chamber--or your body.
